1. Bays A-E clear widths 440 / 440 / 520 / 440 / 440; dividers and end panels 20 thick.
2. Label panels 290 tall, backlit; Ø30 button at bay centre + 170, y 330 (key 1-5).
3. Vitrine clear height 540 (y 400-940), depth 450; 4000 K LED ceiling in the top slab.
4. Staff side: five rear doors, 800 tall, keyed alike; storage behind the vitrines.
5. Tower 520 x 250; screen bezel 430 x 740, active area 398 x 708 (32" portrait).
6. Plinth recessed 50 from the body all round; 6 levelling feet.
7. One 230 V inlet at rear-left of the plinth; about 250 W peak.
8. Keep ACP film on until handover; see sheet 2 for BOM and assumptions.
All dimensions in mm. Concept drawing: confirm on site
